g.text: Accuracy by model, with statistical tests of the condition difference
Bars: accuracy with 95% cluster-bootstrap intervals (20,000 resamples; clusters are BixBench source capsules, otherwise tasks). Brackets: Galaxy vs custom code for each model, paired cluster
sign-flip test (200,000 draws; exact for IWC), Holm-adjusted over the 12 model comparisons: * adj. P < 0.05, ** < 0.01, *** < 0.001, ns not significant. IWC runs count as correct at ≥ 0.99.
